SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 怎麼連安全帶都不會系啊?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: [Mal-sook: Grab some drinks on your way! We’re throwing a party to celebrate Eun-bi coming over.]
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: [高末淑:买点酒来！今晚是恩妃的欢迎派对]

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 오늘... 아까 은비 온 기념으로 술 파티하자는데 괜찮아요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: The others want to have a drinking party to celebrate Eun-bi's arrival. Is that okay with you?

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょうどいいタイミングだね…
私も今日はちょっと飲みたい気分だったんだよね。

นายต้องมานะ, ใช่ไหม?
